verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Elastic Observability supports alerting rules (log threshold, service, environment and transaction levels, custom KQL) and can extend alerts with notifications to services or third-party incident management systems. No evidence item documents registrable outbound HTTP webhook callbacks that a programmatic consumer, such as a remediation script or agent, could receive. Generic notification and incident-management integrations do not qualify as webhooks, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point alert notifications at webhooks that trigger automated remediation or agents
